mapper.select: SELECT , GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,NOW(3),IFNULL(lease_until,NOW(3)))/1000) AS lease_remaining_ms, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,NOW(3),deadline_at)/1000 AS deadline_remaining_ms FROM t_rca_agent_task WHERE task_status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','RETRY_PENDING') AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < NOW(3)) AND attempt_count < max_attempts ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_rca_agent_task SET task_status='RUNNING', lease_owner=#{owner}, lease_generation=lease_generation+1, lease_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), deadline_at=IFNULL(deadline_at,DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL #{taskTimeoutMinutes} MINUTE)), trace_id=IFNULL(trace_id,REPLACE(UUID(),'-','')), attempt_count=attempt_count+1, started_at=IFNULL(started_at,NOW(3)), updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND task_status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','RETRY_PENDING') AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < NOW(3)) AND attempt_count < max_attempts
mapper.select: SELECT , GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,NOW(3),IFNULL(lease_until,NOW(3)))/1000) AS lease_remaining_ms, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,NOW(3),deadline_at)/1000 AS deadline_remaining_ms FROM t_rca_agent_task WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_rca_agent_task SET lease_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_generation=#{generation} AND task_status='RUNNING'

UPDATE t_rca_agent_task SET current_node=#{currentNode}, task_status=#{taskStatus}, stop_reason=#{stopReason}, state_version=state_version+1, state_snapshot=CAST(#{stateSnapshot} AS JSON), snapshot_sha256=#{snapshotSha256}, steps_used=#{stepsUsed}, tokens_used=#{tokensUsed}, cost_used_usd=#{costUsedUsd}, lease_owner=IF(#{taskStatus}='RUNNING',lease_owner,NULL), lease_until=IF(#{taskStatus}='RUNNING',lease_until,NULL), completed_at=IF(#{taskStatus}='RUNNING',completed_at,NOW(3)), updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_generation=#{generation} AND state_version=#{stateVersion}

UPDATE t_rca_agent_task SET task_status='RETRY_PENDING', lease_owner=NULL, lease_until=NULL, error_code=#{errorCode}, error_detail=#{errorDetail}, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_generation=#{generation}

UPDATE t_rca_agent_task SET task_status=#{taskStatus}, stop_reason=#{stopReason}, state_version=state_version+1, lease_owner=NULL, lease_until=NULL, error_code=#{errorCode}, error_detail=#{errorDetail}, completed_at=NOW(3), updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_generation=#{generation}
